caption:
किंग खान के बर्थडे पर ऐसा क्या धमाका हुआ कि फैंस हैरान रह गए? 🔥
शाहरुख खान ने अपने 61वें जन्मदिन पर अपनी आने वाली फिल्म King का नया गाना Tu Mil Jaaye आधी रात को सोशल मीडिया पर शेयर किया।
गाने में शाहरुख और दीपिका पादुकोण की रोमांटिक केमिस्ट्री के साथ जबरदस्त एक्शन भी देखने को मिला है, जहाँ शाहरुख बंदूकों और तलवार से दुश्मनों का खात्मा करते नजर आ रहे हैं।
इस गाने में Arijit Singh और Ed Sheeran की आवाज है, जबकि म्यूजिक Sachin-Jigar ने दिया है और गाने के बोल Kumaar ने लिखे हैं।
सिद्धार्थ आनंद के निर्देशन में बनी यह फिल्म 24 दिसंबर 2026 को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज होगी, जिसमें अभिषेक बच्चन, सुहाना खान, रानी मुखर्जी, रा Raghav Juyal, अरशद वारसी और जयदीप अहलावत भी अहम रोल में हैं।
कुछ फैंस का आरोप है और सोशल मीडिया पर कहना है कि यह गाना Pathaan और Jawan की खिचड़ी जैसा लग रहा है और उन्हें यह Pathaan की सस्ती कॉपी जैसा लगा, जबकि कुछ फैंस शाहरुख के लुक से काफी इंप्रेस भी हुए हैं।
क्या आपको भी King का यह गाना Pathaan और Jawan की याद दिलाता है?

ctx.title: Shah Rukh Khan, Deepika Padukone's romance mixed with action in new King song Tu Mil Jaaye reminds fans of Pathaan and Jawan
ctx.summary: Shah Rukh Khan’s birthday release, Tu Mil Jaaye, features his romance with Deepika Padukone alongside intense action.
ctx.text:
On the occasion of his 61st birthday, Shah Rukh Khan treated fans to a song from his much-awaited film King. Titled Tu Mil Jaaye, the track offers a glimpse of his chemistry with Deepika Padukone , with vocals by Arijit Singh and Ed Sheeran. The song caught the internet's attention, with several fans drawing comparisons to Pathaan and Jawan.
Shah Rukh took to social media at midnight to share Tu Mil Jaaye, featuring Deepika. Sharing the song, he wrote, "This era of love is bestowed upon the fortunate ones... Where roses bloom amidst the fragrance of gunpowder...Of Love and other Battles...This December, #LoveLikeAKing #TuMilJaaye song out now! #KING."
The song shows Shah Rukh deeply in love with Deepika, listening intently to everything she has to say. The video opens with glimpses of their romance, interspersed with action sequences featuring Shah Rukh taking on his enemies using hand-to-hand combat and guns. One sequence also shows the actor setting an entire place ablaze and ruthlessly killing his enemies with a sword. The video ends with Shah Rukh saying, "Aur iss baar dil mein aag lagi hai, toh duniya jalaye bina maanega nahi (And this time, the fire in his heart won’t rest until it sets the world ablaze)."
While some fans were impressed by Shah Rukh's look in the film, others were disappointed with the song's overall vibe. One comment read, "If someone told me this was from Pathaan 2, I would've believed them. I'm hoping King has more to it than just being an action film with beach songs." Another commented, "Looks like a Khichdi of Pathaan and Jawan."
A third comment read, "Is this jawan hangover? SRK-DP romance when he is young and then DP's character dies, and then white hair look SRK has which would be many years later, but the visuals doesn't look vintage so ig maybe not." Another fan wrote, "Wtf did I just watch?? SRK does not look like SRK and DP does not look like DP. It's giving a cheap copy of Pathaan."
The song features vocals by Arijit Singh, Ed Sheeran and Madhubanti, with lyrics by Kumaar and music composed by Sachin-Jigar. Shah Rukh and Deepika's dance moves have been choreographed by Piyush and Shazia.
Helmed by Siddharth Anand, King marks the sixth collaboration between Shah Rukh and Deepika. The film also stars Abhishek Bachchan and Suhana Khan, alongside Rani Mukerji, Raghav Juyal, Arshad Warsi and Jaideep Ahlawat in key roles. The film is scheduled to release in theatres on December 24, 2026.
